I implemented `minidb/tokenizer.py`, and all 22 tests in `tests/test_tokenizer.py` pass. I didn't run the integration tests, and I left the test file as it was.

I didn't try to shave the implementation down to only what the tests check. It does everything the module docstring specifies, including unknown-character errors and a position on every token.
